structural_checks: Scene has unique IDs, no dangling local references, reciprocal hierarchy; only four intended records change and two redundant components are removed
Exactly one CameraRotate on CameraPosition; Main Camera inherits yaw and pitch with no redundant CameraFollow
Initial camera world position/orientation preserved; camera sits at its pitch pivot to prevent orbital position changes while looking vertically
Only scene and two look scripts change; GUIDs preserved; execution order stored in code and metadata; existing game-state gates retained

cases: Input is blocked in missing-manager/Ready/Pause/GameOver/Clear; Playing reads Mouse X/Y once and separates body yaw from pivot pitch
Starting rotation is preserved; pitch clamps at +/-90; yaw wraps; camera stays at its eye position while pitching; no drift over 1000 idle updates
Equal total mouse delta produces equal view at 30/60/144 Hz; variable-frame alternating input is invariant to parent/child rotation order
Player and camera rotation orders precede default-order movement/shooting, so firing uses this frame's aim
Original three world-rotation writers reproduce different camera directions for different legal Update orders; fixed hierarchy is order invariant
behavior_checks.mode: Actual old and patched look scripts compiled and executed against a test-only quaternion/hierarchy model; no Unity Editor

limits: A deterministic duplicate-rotation issue is corrected and reproduced in an API model. Actual perceived smoothness, FPS, display synchronization and OS mouse polling require a Unity Play check.
manual_check: After Ready/Start, slowly sweep mouse left/right/up/down; walk and shoot while turning; pause/resume with P; confirm all 11-chapter flow remains.
